title: Telemetry Consent v1
description: Explicit telemetry consent record for Rig Relay beta telemetry sharing. Records participant opt-in, share level, destination, and consent version. Local consent and remote sharing are separate concerns.

share_level.description: What data may be shared. 'off' means no remote sharing.

destination.description: Remote destination identifier (e.g. google_drive, local, custom).

consent_text_version.description: Version of the consent/onboarding text the participant acknowledged.

can_contact.description: Whether the participant consents to follow-up contact.

revoked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp if consent was revoked.
